security.title: Security
security.subtitle: Manage your account security and protect your business data.
security.overviewSubtitle: Review your account security status and important actions.
security.accountSecureDesc: All security settings are active and up to date.
security.passwordSubtitle: Update your password regularly to keep your account secure.
security.twoFactorSubtitle: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
security.twoFactorEnabledDesc: You'll be required to enter a code when logging in from a new device.
security.setup2FAStep1Desc: Scan this QR code with Google Authenticator, 1Password, or Authy.
security.cantScanQr: Can't scan? Enter this code manually:
security.setup2FAStep2Desc: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
security.setup2FAStep3Desc: Save these emergency codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose your device.
security.disable2FADesc: Enter your account password to confirm disabling two-factor authentication.
security.loginAlertsSubtitle: Get notified about important login activity.
security.loginAlertsEnabledDesc: We'll send you an email when someone logs in to your account.
security.sessionsSubtitle: Manage devices that are currently signed in to your account.
security.deleteAccountSubtitle: Permanently delete your account and all associated data.
security.tipsSubtitle: Follow these best practices to keep your account secure.
security.tip1Desc: Use at least 12 characters with a mix of letters, numbers, and symbols.
security.tip2Desc: Two-factor authentication adds an extra layer of security.
security.tip3Desc: Use a strong password for your email and enable 2FA.
security.tip4Desc: Regularly check and remove unknown devices.
security.needHelpDesc: If you notice any suspicious activity or need help securing your account, our support team is here for you.

dataExport.title: Data & Export
dataExport.description: Download and export all your business records, transaction ledgers, customer directory, and invoices in clean Excel or branded PDF.
dataExport.completeArchiveDesc: Export a unified enterprise archive containing all transactions, full customer CRM registry with IDs and order numbers, invoices ledger, and financial KPI summaries.
dataExport.modularExportsDesc: Select and download individual modules in Excel (.xlsx) or PDF format.
dataExport.transactionsDesc: All recorded revenue, expenses, split entries, categories, payment methods, and timestamps.
dataExport.customersDesc: Complete directory with Customer IDs, associated Order Numbers, total lifetime spend, and billing stats.
dataExport.invoicesDesc: All invoice numbers, client associations, issuance/due dates, total amounts, and payment statuses.
dataExport.reportsDesc: Breakdown of operating income, cost distribution, gross profit margin, and net bottom-line cash flow.
dataExport.securityDesc: All exported files are formatted with UTF-8 encoding to guarantee seamless support for Arabic calligraphy, symbols, and currency formats in Microsoft Excel, Adobe Acrobat, and Apple Numbers.
